{{DISPLAYTITLE:Timeline of events in ''Pokémon the Series: Gold and Silver''}}
{{spoilers}}
In {{aniseries|GS}}, [[Ash Ketchum]] continues his quest to become a [[Pokémon Master]] by {{pkmn|journey}}ing through the [[Johto]] [[region]] alongside {{ashfr}} {{an|Misty}} and {{an|Brock}}. Starting from [[New Bark Town]], he aims to collect eight [[Johto League]] [[Badge|Gym Badges]] to qualify for the [[Silver Conference|Johto League Conference]]. Along the way, Ash catches new Pokémon, encounters [[Legendary Pokémon]] like {{p|Suicune}} and {{p|Lugia}}, and faces both old and new [[rival]]s.
